notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. TC-series sheet TC1033_2 'Narrow shoulders' special hazard warning sign, two lanes (two cars) (2014; page 2 of 3). Diamond, table a / b / c / d / e / f / r: size B 750 side generated (C 900, D 1200 also tabled; no size A), drawn as the bounding square 750 x 1.41421 = 1060.66 (centre 530.33), r 40, yellow edge b 10 + black border c 20 (the sheet's diamond is drawn with a thinner edge and border than tabled; the table governs). Symbol box d wide, e below and f above the sign's horizontal centreline, centred. d 675 (the table prints '6750', a typo: sizes C 810 and D 1080 are 0.9 x a, so 0.9 x 750), e 84, f 131: box x 192.83, y 399.33, 675 x 215 (the drawn symbol's aspect 3.14 matches the box). The drawing's 'R80' callout is read as r 40 per the table for size B. Symbol extracted from the sheet PDF's own filled vector path (tools/symbols/qld_tc1033_two_cars_cones.svg). Black on retroreflective yellow.
